text: うえには　うえが　いるって　おしえて　あげます！

structure.jp: うえには　うえが　いるって
おしえて　あげます！

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual spoken form of と, which shows what is being said or taught. うえが　いるって = 'that there is someone better'.

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.span: おしえて　あげます
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form means doing something as a favor for someone; said to an opponent it sounds cocky. おしえて　あげます = 'I'll teach you'.
